subject: UPDATED: PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI FOR FRIDAY, MAY 22, 2026
plaintextBody:
City Seal 170

May 22, 2026 

*FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY*  

*CONTACT:* pressoffice@cityhall.nyc.gov   

  

*UPDATED: PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI*  

*FOR FRIDAY, MAY 22, 2026* 

  

"On Friday, Mayor Mamdani will visit the 2026 New York City Continuity of Operations (COOP) full-scale exercise training. This event will be pooled by NYC Media and distributed after the stop." 

 

"Then, the Mayor will host the Black, Puerto Rican, Hispanic and Asian Legislative Caucus’ (BPHA) meeting. This event is closed to press." 

 

"After, the Mayor will deliver remarks and meet with a hero New York City Fire Department (FDNY) flood rescue first responder. This event is open to press."

 

"Later, the Mayor will deliver remarks at an FDNY press conference on the Staten Island explosion. This event is open to press."

" "

_*Press Schedule*_:" "  

 

*8:15 AM – Visits the 2026 New York City Continuity of Operations (COOP) Full-Scale Exercise Training* 

"This event will be pooled by NYC Media and distributed after the stop." 

 

*11:00 AM – Hosts BPHA Caucus Meeting* 

"This event is closed to press." 

 

*12:30 PM – Delivers Remarks and Meets with Hero FDNY Flood Rescue First Responder*

"FDNY Headquarters; 9 MetroTech Center, Brooklyn, NY 11201."

"This event is open to press." 

 

*7:30 PM (Approx.) ***–* Delivers Remarks at FDNY Press Conference on Staten Island Explosion" "*

"Staten Island University Hospital - North Campus; 475 Seaview Ave, Staten Island, NY 10305"

"This event is open to press."

Photos will be available here [ https://www.flickr.com/photos/nycmayorsoffice/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ].
